svg.text: Two side plates shaped round both sprockets, 12 mm outside the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: chain, joined by a 26 mm rim strip; 703 long, 253 tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes: 28 mm for the crank axle and for the jackshaft.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Where it crosses the left gearbox member the bottom is flat and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rests on the member (one M6 bolt).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tab 25 wide to the pedal post (one M6 bolt).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make the outer plate removable for fitting the chain.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: inner plate 4 mm off the gearbox; outer plate 2 mm inside
